item.title: Tesla made smallest annual profit since the pandemic, plans to spend big on robotaxis and robots
item.description: It was the second year in a row with a steep drop in profit.

item.title: Zyanna Walker eager for return to K-State, leading CU Buffs into Big 12 road test
item.description: During the previous two years, Zyanna Walker made some great memories and played in big games for Kansas State. On Thursday, she’ll get a different perspective of Bramlage Coliseum in Manhattan, Kansas.

item.title: Denver stops automatically mailing property tax bills as process moves online
item.description: Residents who don’t have access to a computer can request that the city mail them a copy by of their property tax statement by calling 720-913-9300 or 311.

item.title: Broncos QB Bo Nix denies ‘any predisposed issues’ with ankle, clarifies 4-6 week recovery timeline
item.description: Bo Nix wants the world to know: he has no concerns, moving forward in his career, that he's any kind of injury-prone quarterback.

item.title: Jury finds former Colorado senator guilty of four felonies for faked letters of support in probe
item.description: The falsely attributed letters drew the attention of the Denver District Attorney’s Office, which brought the felony charges against Jaquez Lewis.

item.title: Rapids nearing deal to send star Homegrown Cole Bassett to Portland Timbers, source confirms
item.description: The best Homegrown player in Colorado Rapids history is close to being dealt to a conference rival.

item.title: Keeler: Nuggets’ Michael Porter Jr. trade has new winner: Peyton Watson
item.description: Did you know that the Nuggets' Peyton Watson never got more than 14 field-goal attempts in a regular-season game while Michael Porter, Jr. was here?

item.title: Avalanche offense goes missing in ‘flat’ 5-2 loss to Senators
item.description: The Colorado Avalanche authored a comprehensive performance three days ago in Toronto, but that version of the league-leading club did not travel to the other side of Ontario.

item.title: Police search for three Aurora sisters reported missing
item.description: Aurora police are seeking the public's help in locating three sisters who left their home near E. 22nd Avenue and Sable Boulevard on Wednesday, officials announced on X.
